title: Fiesta Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: A flavorful and colorful vegetarian dish, perfect for any occasion. This recipe combines the sweetness of bell peppers with the spice of fiesta seasoning.
instructions: Cut the tops off the bell peppers and remove the seeds and membranes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, black beans, fiesta seasoning, and shredded cheese.
Stuff each bell pepper with the rice mixture and top with tomato sauce.
Place the bell peppers in a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes.
